title: Longest Clean Burst

story.briefing: A burst is clean while no character repeats inside it. The longest clean burst in the capture tells the engineers how much bandwidth the line can actually hold.
story.success: Clean burst measured. The line is re-rated and the forest gets its bandwidth back.

description: Given a string, return the length of the longest contiguous stretch in which no character appears more than once. An empty string returns 0.
hints: The window here is not a fixed size — it grows while the stretch stays clean and has to shrink the moment a repeat appears.
When a repeat appears, moving the left edge one step at a time is correct but slow. Remembering where each character was last seen lets you jump the left edge straight past the earlier copy.

Track the last index of every character. Walk the right edge forward; when the current character was last seen at or after the left edge, move the left edge to just past that position. Record the width at every step.
